digest.component_or_area: documentation surfaces: CLI help, ticket model, event schema
propositions: The packaged top-level CLI overview (overview.txt) and ticket-model documentation state unlink accepts no relation argument, contradicting the current optional relation parameter shipped in commit 73abb5805f.
Event-schema operation wording conflates optional relation selection with the emitted UNLINK cancellation event, requiring clarification of link_uuid targeting versus selector omission fallback.
The omitted-relation most-recent fallback behavior must be explicitly documented as the preserved contract when no relation selector is provided.
Explicit canonical relation selection must be documented to remove exactly that relation while preserving other active relations on the source-target pair.
Documentation surfaces (overview.txt, ticket-model.md, event-schema.md) were not updated when relation-scoped unlink shipped, leaving published contracts and live CLI behavior contradictory.
